Health Minister JP Nadda Undergoes Angioplasty, Condition Stable

Union Health and Family Welfare Minister JP Nadda underwent an angioplasty procedure at AIIMS Delhi on August 17. Doctors in the cardiology department performed the procedure. His condition is reported to be stable following the surgery. The angioplasty is a heart procedure performed to open blocked arteries.
